messages.author: 45ab19873a8c2cfb
messages.subject: Missing lines
parts:
Could anyone more knowledgeable than myself kindly point out my error? If I use

p <- ggplot(Fig_2_new_long, aes(x=Month_num,y=quantity)) +
  geom_line(aes(colour=type)) + #Plot lines by type
  geom_point(aes(colour=type), size=3) + #Plot points by type
  scale_colour_manual(values=c("#DF5F24", "#00AAF2", "#48AB28", "black")) + #Add colour
  theme(legend.position="none") #Remove legend

where Month-num contains the values 3, 4...12, and their are four categories of type, I obtain a line graph with four lines, and data points. But if I use

p <- ggplot(Fig_2_new_long, aes(x=factor(Month_num), y=quantity)) +
  geom_line(aes(colour=type)) + #Plot lines by type
  geom_point(aes(colour=type), size=3) + #Plot points by type
  scale_colour_manual(values=c("#DF5F24", "#00AAF2", "#48AB28", "black")) + #Add colour
  theme(legend.position="none") #Remove legend

in which I a using factor(Month_num) to obtain a discrete x-axis, the points are all plotted as in the previous example but the lines are missing.

I am obviously doing something wrong, but what?

With grateful thanks, Martino

messages.author: 45ab19873a8c2cfb
messages.subject: Re: Missing lines
parts:
Thank you very much, and also for the useful explanation. Using

p <- ggplot(Fig_2_new_long, aes(x=factor(Month_num), y=quantity,
group=type)) +

geom_line(aes(colour=type)) + #Plot lines by type
geom_point(aes(colour=type), size=3) + #Plot points by type
scale_colour_manual(values=c("#DF5F24", "#00AAF2", "#48AB28", "black"))
+ #Add colour
theme(legend.position="none") #Remove legend

now produces a plot that also contains the lines.

Martino
